legal.policyIntro: TiangPass is the Association’s same-day fishing pass system for authorised Penang Bridge pillars. This notice explains how we collect, use, disclose, and protect personal data under the Malaysian Personal Data Protection Act 2010 (PDPA).
legal.dataUserBody: {org} is the data user for angler, operator, and Association Admin personal data processed through TiangPass.
legal.contactPending: Ask Association staff at the jetty for the privacy contact until Admin sets a live email under Settings.
legal.dataCollect.1: Identity and contact: name, email, mobile, emergency contact name and number, address, MyKad (stored as a one-way hash; last four digits kept for display), date of birth, citizenship.
legal.dataCollect.2: Identity photo: a live camera capture at sign-up for operator visual checks at boarding. File upload is not accepted.
legal.dataCollect.3: Location: device GPS when you buy a pass and when an operator scans your QR, to confirm you are at the authorised jetty.
legal.dataCollect.4: Pass and operations: jetty and pillar, payment status, boarding QR, check-in and check-out times, and an audit log of who did what.
legal.dataCollect.5: Technical: sign-in session cookie, language preference, and cookie acknowledgement.
legal.purpose.1: Create and manage your account and Association fishing passes.
legal.purpose.2: Confirm you are at an authorised jetty before purchase and boarding.
legal.purpose.3: Let boat operators match the person boarding with the pass photo and QR.
legal.purpose.4: Run safety, capacity, and incident operations for the Association.
legal.purpose.5: Keep an audit trail for support, disputes, and Association rules.
legal.purpose.6: Send password-reset email when you request it.
legal.basisBody: When you register you consent to this Privacy Notice, the Consent notice, the Terms of Use, and location use for jetty checks. Identity, pass, and boarding records are also needed to run Association fishing under bridge rules. You may withdraw consent where the law allows, but we cannot issue or board a pass without identity and jetty location checks.
legal.disclosureBody: Data may be shared with authorised boat operators and Association Admin for boarding and ops; with the payment provider (Stripe or HitPay) when you pay; and with the mail host for password-reset messages. We disclose data to authorities only where the law requires it. We do not sell personal data.
legal.retentionBody: Account and pass records are kept while your account is active and for a reasonable period afterward for audit, safety, and claims (often up to seven years for financial and ops records, or as the Association requires). Identity photos stay with the pass and account record until you delete your account or Admin removes them under Association policy.
legal.rightsBody: Subject to PDPA exceptions, you may request access to or correction of your personal data, and withdraw consent. Contact us using the details above. We may verify your identity before acting. You can also delete and anonymise your account from Profile.
legal.securityBody: Passwords are stored hashed. Photos and sessions are access-controlled. No method of transmission or storage is fully secure; report suspected misuse promptly.
legal.safetyBody: You remain solely responsible for your own safety at the jetty, under the bridge, and on any vessel. Provide an accurate emergency contact and follow operator instructions. Fishing and boarding involve inherent risks of injury, illness, property damage, and death.
legal.safetyTermsLink: Limitation of liability and assumption of risk are set out in the
legal.consentIntro: By creating a TiangPass account or buying a fishing pass, you give informed consent for the Association to process your personal data as described in the Privacy Notice.
legal.consent.1: Identity verification: name, MyKad-derived details, and a live identity photo so operators can match the person boarding to the pass.
legal.consent.2: Location for purchase and boarding: device location to confirm you are within the jetty purchase radius and during operator scan events.
legal.consent.3: Pass and QR: an opaque boarding QR for your pass, scanned by authorised operators for check-in and check-out.
legal.consent.4: Emergency contact: contacting the number you provide if operators need to reach someone on your behalf.
legal.consent.5: Audit: recording who performed operational actions (for example payment and check-in) for support and Association rules.
legal.consentWithdrawBody: You may withdraw consent by contacting Association Admin or deleting your account from Profile. Withdrawal does not undo processing already completed. Without identity photo and location consent we cannot issue or board Association passes.
legal.consentChildrenBody: Angler accounts are for Malaysian citizens aged 14 and above. Guardians should supervise younger teens using the service.
legal.cookiesIntro: This Cookies Policy explains how TiangPass uses cookies and similar technologies. It should be read together with our
legal.cookiesWhatBody: Cookies are small text files stored on your device. Similar technologies include local storage used by the browser. We use them only as needed to operate TiangPass securely and to remember essential preferences.
legal.cookiesNecessaryBody: Authentication session cookie (keeps you signed in), security-related session handling, and cookie-acknowledgement record (tiangpass_cookie_consent) so we know you have seen this notice.
legal.cookiesFunctionalBody: Language preference (tiangpass_locale) and optional local flags such as dismissing the install prompt, so the interface works as you expect across visits.
legal.cookiesAnalyticsBody: We do not set advertising, tracking, or third-party analytics cookies.
legal.cookiesManageBody: On first visit you acknowledge necessary cookies. You may clear site cookies and site data in your browser settings; the acknowledgement banner may appear again. Blocking strictly necessary cookies may prevent sign-in, language switching, or secure use of the service.
legal.cookiesLocalBody: We may use browser local storage for the cookie acknowledgement mirror, install-prompt dismissal, and offline boarding packs for operators. This data stays on your device and is not used for advertising.
legal.cookiesThirdBody: When you pay, you may leave TiangPass for Stripe or HitPay checkout pages, which are governed by those providers’ own cookie and privacy policies. We do not control cookies set on those domains.
legal.bannerBody: We use necessary cookies to keep you signed in and remember your language. See our Cookies Policy, Terms of Use, and Privacy Notice.
legal.termsIntro: These Terms of Use (“Terms”) govern your access to and use of TiangPass, the digital fishing-pass platform operated for {org} (the “Association”), together with authorised boat operators and service providers supporting the platform (together, the “Providers”). By creating an account, purchasing a pass, or using TiangPass, you agree to these Terms.
legal.terms.acceptanceBody: If you do not agree to these Terms, the Privacy Notice, the Consent notice, or the Cookies Policy, you must not use TiangPass. Continued use after updates constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.
legal.terms.serviceBody: TiangPass facilitates same-day Association fishing passes for authorised Penang Bridge pillars, identity checks, payment of Association fees, and operator boarding scans. TiangPass is a technology and administration tool. It does not sell fishing rights beyond Association rules, does not provide marine transport insurance, and does not supervise your conduct on the water.
legal.terms.eligibilityBody: Angler accounts are intended for Malaysian citizens aged 14 years and above who provide accurate identity and contact information. You must keep your credentials confidential and are responsible for activity under your account.
legal.terms.conduct.1: Select the correct jetty and pillar before payment; verify details on screen before you pay.
legal.terms.conduct.2: Comply with Association rules, operator instructions, capacity limits, and applicable law.
legal.terms.conduct.3: Do not misuse QR codes, share passes fraudulently, harass staff, or interfere with platform security.
legal.terms.conduct.4: Do not fish or board if you are unfit, intoxicated, or otherwise unable to do so safely.
legal.terms.refundBody: Association fees paid through TiangPass are generally non-refundable once payment is successfully completed, including where you later cancel a pass that has not been checked in. Without limiting the foregoing:
legal.terms.refund.1: No refund will be given if you selected the wrong pillar, wrong jetty, or wrong fishing date or slot, whether by mistake, misunderstanding, or change of mind.
legal.terms.refund.2: No refund will be given if you cancel an active or pending pass to change pillar or otherwise re-purchase; any new pass requires a new fee.
legal.terms.refund.3: Failed, abandoned, or unpaid checkout sessions do not create a paid pass; a reservation may expire without charge where payment was never completed.
legal.terms.refund.4: Where a payment provider or law requires a chargeback review, the Association may investigate and act in accordance with Association policy and applicable law. Discretionary goodwill refunds, if any, are not an admission of liability.
legal.terms.liability: 6. Assumption of risk and limitation of liability
legal.terms.liabilityBody: Fishing from or near Penang Bridge pillars, jetties, boats, and related facilities involves inherent and significant risks, including but not limited to slipping, falling, drowning, collision, equipment failure, weather and sea conditions, acts of other persons, and medical emergencies. To the fullest extent permitted by Malaysian law:
legal.terms.liability.1: You voluntarily assume all risks of injury, illness, disability, death, and loss of or damage to property arising from your use of TiangPass, presence at the jetty or bridge, boarding, fishing, and related activities.
legal.terms.liability.2: The Association, TiangPass operators, boat owners, handlers, administrators, developers, and hosting or payment Providers shall not be liable for any injury, death, accident, loss, or damage suffered by you or any third party in connection with fishing, boarding, transport, or use of the facilities, except to the extent such exclusion is prohibited by mandatory law.
legal.terms.liability.3: The Providers are not liable for indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive losses, or for loss of profits, data, or opportunity, even if advised of the possibility of such loss.
legal.terms.liability.4: Where liability cannot be excluded, the Providers’ aggregate liability arising from your use of TiangPass shall not exceed the Association fee you paid for the specific pass giving rise to the claim.
legal.terms.liabilityAck: By using TiangPass you confirm that you understand this allocation of risk and that responsibility for your safety and conduct rests with you (and, where applicable, your guardian).
legal.terms.indemnityBody: You agree to indemnify and hold harmless the Association and Providers from claims, losses, and expenses (including reasonable legal fees) arising from your breach of these Terms, misuse of the service, or your acts or omissions at the jetty, under the bridge, or on board, except to the extent caused by the Providers’ wilful misconduct where mandatory law so requires.
legal.terms.changesBody: We may update these Terms from time to time. The “Last updated” date will change when we do. Material changes may be highlighted in the app or at the jetty. Continued use after the effective date constitutes acceptance.
legal.terms.lawBody: These Terms are governed by the laws of Malaysia. Courts in Malaysia have exclusive jurisdiction, without prejudice to any non-excludable consumer rights.
pwa.bannerBody: Add TiangPass to your home screen so your pass opens in one tap.
pwa.guideTitle: Add TiangPass to your home screen
pwa.once: You only need to do this once.
pwa.ios.lead: iPhone does not show an Install button. Use Safari.
pwa.iosOpenSafari: This browser cannot install the app. Open this page in Safari, then follow the steps.
pwa.ios.1: Tap the Share button at the bottom of Safari. It is a square with an arrow pointing up.
pwa.ios.2: Scroll the share menu and tap Add to Home Screen.
pwa.ios.3: Tap Add at the top right.
pwa.ios.4: Open TiangPass from the new icon on your home screen.
pwa.android.lead: Chrome can install TiangPass like an app.
pwa.androidInApp: Open this page in Chrome first. A browser inside another app cannot install TiangPass.
pwa.android.1: Tap the menu button: three dots at the top right.
pwa.android.2: Tap Install app. If you do not see it, tap Add to Home screen.
pwa.android.4: Open TiangPass from your home screen or app list.
pwa.other.lead: Use Chrome on Android, or Safari on iPhone.
pwa.other.1: On Android Chrome, open the three-dot menu and tap Install app or Add to Home screen.
pwa.other.2: On iPhone Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen, then Add.
